snippet.title: Sega Saturn - Houma Hunter Lime Perfect Collection (1995) - Opening
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Houma Hunter Lime Perfect Collection is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Copya Systems and published by Asmik Ace Entertainment, Inc, which was released in Japan in 1995.
